sentences.en: Listen to this chaotic story while I naturally use IN, ON, and AT. Listen to this English story.

sentences.en: We went to Puerto Escondido, a beautiful beach IN Mexico. It is ON the coast of the Pacific Ocean. It is famous for big waves, beautiful sunsets, and warm weather all year.
sentences.tc: 我們去了墨西哥美麗的埃斯孔迪多港海灘。它位於太平洋沿岸。它以大浪、美麗的日落和全年溫暖的天氣而聞名。

sentences.en: Long. It was a chaotic trip to the beach. It started very early.
sentences.tc: 長的。這是一趟混亂的海灘之旅。事情很早就開始了。
